Online shopping definitely has its pros, especially convenience and more options, but physical shopping is just so much better in this way. You can actually see the colour, touch the fabric, check the fit and know what you're paying for before buying it.

And with online shopping, even after checking everything properly, sometimes what arrives is still completely different 😭 The return issues just make the whole thing more stressful.

And delivery can be a headache too. Last month I ordered a night suit and had to travel almost 8 km just to pick up the package because the courier service said my area was outside their delivery range.
